verdict.rationale: Statsig ships several automated, condition-triggered behaviors — Autotune automatically reallocates traffic based on live metric performance, alerts fire on detected regressions, and gates can auto-add users by email domain or run scheduled rollouts — which are all forms of rules triggering actions on events/conditions. However, there is no documented general-purpose 'if event X then action Y' automation/rule engine or webhook system for arbitrary custom actions. Missing for 10: a dedicated event-driven automation/rules engine (e.g., webhooks or custom triggers), evidence of user-defined arbitrary actions beyond flag/traffic management, and independent confirmation of these automated behaviors working in practice.
